summary: Iteration 120: SaaS Plan System Testing. All 29 tests passed. The flexible subscription plan system is fully functional with 4 plans (free/standard/pro/enterprise), admin-controlled per-seller overrides, dynamic limits via get_effective_limits(), and override priority over plan defaults.

minor.issue: Requires user to exist in users collection before setting override. Standard user (69c4c9085fb00a2104f25fa4) exists in subscriptions but not in users collection, so override cannot be set for them.

frontend_issues.notes: Backend-only testing as requested. Frontend subscription UI not tested.

critical_code_review_comments: ✓ GET /api/subscription/status returns correct plan and features for admin user (enterprise)
✓ GET /api/business-tools/access-level returns correct plan + limits (no 500 error)
✓ POST /api/admin/subscription/override sets overrides on user subscription
✓ Invalid override keys are rejected with 400
✓ Override type validation works: boolean fields must be boolean, number fields must be numbers
✓ Unknown plan names (trial/starter) fall back to free limits via get_plan_config()
✓ Pro plan user (69c4c81605e9972a11b16366) has planName=pro with correct default limits (maxPanels=50, maxRules=200)
✓ Standard plan user (69c4c9085fb00a2104f25fa4) has planName=standard with correct default limits (maxPanels=10, maxRules=50)
✓ Free plan has correct default limits (maxPanels=3, maxRules=10, export=false)
✓ Overrides merge with plan defaults: override takes priority
✓ Enterprise plan user gets unlimited limits (maxPanels=-1, maxRules=-1)
✓ Only 4 valid plans exist: free, standard, pro, enterprise (NO trial/starter)
✓ PLAN_CONFIG in config/plan_features.py is the Single Source of Truth
✓ get_effective_limits() correctly merges plan defaults with per-seller overrides
seed_data_creation: Tests use existing users: admin (dev-test-token), pro user (69c4c81605e9972a11b16366), standard user (69c4c9085fb00a2104f25fa4). Override tests cleanup after themselves.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 120 tested the SaaS Plan System. Key findings: (1) 4 plans exist: free/standard/pro/enterprise (NO trial/starter). (2) PLAN_CONFIG in config/plan_features.py is SSOT with limits: free(3 panels, 10 rules, no export), standard(10 panels, 50 rules, export), pro(50 panels, 200 rules, export), enterprise(unlimited). (3) Admin override CRUD works: POST/GET/DELETE /api/admin/subscription/override. (4) Override validation: invalid keys rejected (400), type validation enforced (boolean/number). (5) get_effective_limits() merges plan defaults with overrides, override takes priority. (6) Admin user (dev-test-token) has enterprise plan with unlimited limits. (7) Pro user (69c4c81605e9972a11b16366) and standard user (69c4c9085fb00a2104f25fa4) exist in subscriptions collection. (8) /api/business-tools/access-level endpoint works without 500 error (was fixed - previously used undefined MAX_PANELS_PER_BUSINESS).
